fixed_readings: Military Saddle Advantage applies to ability checks to remain mounted, not to the DC 10 Dexterity saving throw for falling off (PDF16, PDF100).
A damage instance equal to the damage threshold is taken in full (PDF180 'equal to or greater than').

PDF5 Round Down is applied where the source counts whole things or says so: mounting cost (PDF15 'round down') and private-accommodation passengers (PDF101). It is not applied to a halved vessel speed or a halved repair time: the PDF101 table prints 1½ and 2½ mph, and a rounded 1 Hit Point shipyard repair would take 0 days. Rejected results: Warship 1 mile, 15 HP in 7 days, 1 HP in 0 days.

Under sail or rowed is a declared fact for each affected vessel hour. A rowed Keelboat or Rowboat uses its table speed (PDF100 'can’t be rowed against any significant current'); no other row has a rowed speed.

Of the PDF100 table animals, Horse, Draft; Horse, Riding; Warhorse and Mule are read as domesticated horses and mules (PDF16). Camel, Elephant, Mastiff and Pony are 'similar creatures' only by authoritative fact.
